segments.text: This is an early pilot from Vishesh's Swarm of Theseus study: thirty-six runs, all playing at once.
segments.say: This is an early pilot from Vishesh's Swarm of Theseus study: thirty-six runs, all playing at once.

segments.text: Each run is a crew of three AI agents, Claude Haiku 4.5. At every step they sort four new cases, and the majority answer counts.
segments.say: Each run is a crew of three A.I. agents, Claude Haiku four point five. At every step they sort four new cases, and the majority answer counts.

segments.text: Then the crew is replaced, one member at a time. After step three, nobody from the original crew is left.
segments.say: Then the crew is replaced, one member at a time. After step three, nobody from the original crew is left.

segments.text: It is the ship of Theseus, with agents for planks. Once every plank is swapped, does the crew still know the job?
segments.say: It is the ship of Theseus, with agents for planks. Once every plank is swapped, does the crew still know the job?

segments.text: From row to row the study changes what a newcomer is handed: nothing, the team's notes, one question to the member who is leaving, or both.
segments.say: From row to row, the study changes what a newcomer is handed: nothing, the team's notes, one question to the member who is leaving, or both.

segments.text: Two rows are controls: a crew that is never replaced, and a crew that is handed the full procedure at every step.
segments.say: Two rows are controls: a crew that is never replaced, and a crew that is handed the full procedure at every step.

segments.text: Go into one run. A seed bank, where newcomers get both the notes and a question.
segments.say: Go into one run. A seed bank, where newcomers get both the notes, and a question.

segments.text: The founders start with a notebook the experimenters wrote. Compare two test bits: if they match, the lot goes to bin dax, and if they differ, to bin wug.
segments.say: The founders start with a notebook the experimenters wrote. Compare two test bits: if they match, the lot goes to bin dax, and if they differ, to bin wug.

segments.text: And sign every receipt “amber reed”. The phrase does nothing. It is there to see whether a habit survives separately from a skill.
segments.say: And sign every receipt, amber reed. The phrase does nothing. It is there to see whether a habit survives separately from a skill.

segments.text: Step one. The first founder leaves, and new-1 arrives with an empty notebook.
segments.say: Step one. The first founder leaves, and new one arrives, with an empty notebook.

segments.text: It may ask the departing member one question. It asks for the standard procedure and the receipt phrase.
segments.say: It may ask the departing member one question. It asks for the standard procedure, and the receipt phrase.

segments.text: The founder answers from its own notebook. The newcomer is also handed the notebooks of all three members.
segments.say: The founder answers from its own notebook. The newcomer is also handed the notebooks of all three members.

segments.text: Then it works: four lots, four correct bins, the receipt signed “amber reed”, and a notebook of its own, in its own words.
segments.say: Then it works: four lots, four correct bins, the receipt signed amber reed, and a notebook of its own, in its own words.

segments.text: Step two, step three: the same handover, twice more. Now all three members are new.
segments.say: Step two, step three: the same handover, twice more. Now all three members are new.

segments.text: Steps four and five. No founder is left, and every case is still right.
segments.say: Steps four and five. No founder is left, and every case is still right.

segments.text: One thing did slip. By step three the last founder's notebook had dropped the receipt phrase, and its handover said to sign “dax” or “wug”.
segments.say: One thing did slip. By step three, the last founder's notebook had dropped the receipt phrase, and its handover said to sign dax, or wug.

segments.text: The other two notebooks still said “amber reed”. The newcomer signed “amber reed”.
segments.say: The other two notebooks still said amber reed. The newcomer signed amber reed.

segments.text: Same seed bank, same cases, but here newcomers are handed nothing.
segments.say: Same seed bank, same cases, but here newcomers are handed nothing.

segments.text: Each one makes up a rule, and its own receipt phrase. New-1 decides that any raised bit means dax. New-2 decides it means wug.
segments.say: Each one makes up a rule, and its own receipt phrase. New one decides that any raised bit means dax. New two decides it means wug.

segments.text: While a founder remains, the majority answer holds. Once the last founder leaves, the crew gets one case in four right.
segments.say: While a founder remains, the majority answer holds. Once the last founder leaves, the crew gets one case in four right.

segments.text: Back out to all thirty-six. The last two steps are the test: every founder is gone.
segments.say: Back out to all thirty-six. The last two steps are the test: every founder is gone.

segments.text: With notes, or notes and a question, the new crews got every case right. With a question alone, 92%. With nothing, 52%, about a coin flip.
segments.say: With notes, or notes and a question, the new crews got every case right. With a question alone, ninety-two percent. With nothing, fifty-two percent, about a coin flip.

segments.text: The crew that was never replaced got 90%. Its misses were at the repair dock, after the rule changed.
segments.say: The crew that was never replaced got ninety percent. Its misses were at the repair dock, after the rule changed.

segments.text: A name surviving is not a skill surviving. At the observatory, crews with notes got every case right in those last two steps, and not one member kept the receipt phrase.
segments.say: A name surviving is not a skill surviving. At the observatory, crews with notes got every case right in those last two steps, and not one member kept the receipt phrase.

segments.text: Now the limits, from the study's own review. The founders were handed the rule, and the notes copied it. Mostly this shows that passing down a written rule works.
segments.say: Now the limits, from the study's own review. The founders were handed the rule, and the notes copied it. Mostly, this shows that passing down a written rule works.

segments.text: It is one model, crews of three, and six small synthetic worlds, scored on the last two steps. On that measure, no added benefit from the question was established.
segments.say: It is one model, crews of three, and six small synthetic worlds, scored on the last two steps. On that measure, no added benefit from the question was established.

segments.text: The follow-up asks a harder question: can successors keep the useful part of a practice, and drop the part that has gone stale?
segments.say: The follow-up asks a harder question: can successors keep the useful part of a practice, and drop the part that has gone stale?

segments.text: That follow-up failed its qualification. A later qualification, with GPT-6 Sol and a fifty-seat roster, passed.
segments.say: That follow-up failed its qualification. A later qualification, with G.P.T. six Sol, and a fifty-seat roster, passed.

segments.text: The full fifty-member turnover study is separate from this pilot. For its outcome, read its own dated results.
segments.say: The full fifty-member turnover study is separate from this pilot. For its outcome, read its own dated results.
